graphics.text: Active low, open-drain converter \ndisable output, referenced to RTN.

Connect resistor from CLS to VSS to 
program classification current.
The controller places a voltage of 
approximately 2.5V across the 
external resistor whenever the 
voltage differential between VDD and 
VSS lies from about 10.9V to 22V.
If not used, connect APD to RTN.
The PowerPadTM must \nbe connected to VSS.
